annotations.text: Supersedes only WK-2054's unfinished remediation and exposure tail; preserves delivered generic owners.
Operator-authorized direct-main delivery requires exact-landed-change review and no forge handoff.

Hand-authored integration proof rigor decisions: supersession=critical_semantic; currentness=critical_semantic; precreate-describe=critical_semantic; mcp-family=critical_semantic; authoring-semantics=critical_semantic; bounds=critical_semantic; role-policy=critical_semantic; discovery-parity=critical_semantic; nonauthority=critical_semantic; regressions=standard; documentation=standard; wk2415-unblock=standard; direct-main=standard.

All ten adequacy axes are applicable to WK-2417: registered routes, selector partitions, authority producer/consumer edges, exact role-tool profiles, failure phases, result-schema population, persistent refs/state, concurrency/interleavings, declared mutants, and prohibited stubs. Unsupported provider-backed censuses must remain explicit incomplete evidence and cannot be inferred as pass.

Hand-authored design-time adequacy assessment over the criterion-bound contract: pass; 10/10 axes decided, 13/13 requirements joined, 13/13 integration-required obligations have concrete scenarios, 71/71 applicable complete census members have scenarios, and fail/incomplete/unevaluable/review_only diagnostics are all zero. This is design sufficiency only and grants no runtime or implementation correctness guarantee.

Registered-route census (5): workspace_controlled_contract_acceptance_coverage_describe, _create, _upsert, _remove, and _query. Every credited scenario action begins at the exact public route boundary.

Selector-partition census (7): root WK subject, slice subject, valid criterion index, invalid criterion index, carrier absent, carrier present-current, and carrier present-stale. Each partition has an exact declared input.

Authority-edge census (6): canonical resolver to describe/create/upsert/remove, role policy to MCP registration, and registered provider to currentness check. Scenarios observe production producers and never replace authority results.
Exact role-profile census (5): orchestrator, operator, reviewer, redteam, and worker. Each profile proves equality across registered, returned, invoked, and completed tool sets.

Failure-phase census (8): missing source, missing carrier, invalid selector, stale currentness, duplicate credit, oversize, busy, and final compare. Each phase has an injected failure identity and exact typed expected result.

Persistent-state census (5): describe preserves absence, create absent-to-present, upsert present-to-present, remove present-to-present-or-empty, and refusal preserves before-state. Fixtures observe required absence and never pre-create it.

Concurrency/interleaving census (5): simultaneous create, stale upsert after winner, stale remove after winner, busy lock contention, and final-compare race. Each case has an explicit concurrency constraint and proves loser/refusal no-state-change.

Each of the 13 criterion-bound scenarios declares a canonical input, exact public action, typed expected result, ordinary node:test discovery binding for its mutant, kill oracle, public observations, forbidden side effects, follow-up set, falsifiers, and closed writable roots. Source inspection, test-count-only, unexecuted assertions, and mock-only authority substitution are prohibited.

identity.value: SUPERSESSION. Replace only WK-2054's unfinished current-main remediation and MCP/discovery exposure tail. Reuse its delivered obligation carrier, evaluator, canonical resolver/currentness owner, mutation/query operations, cursor, state vocabulary, and controlled-contract registration family; create no parallel owner.

CORE CURRENTNESS. Repair only defects preventing existing acceptance-coverage operations from consuming complete server-authenticated facts and returning typed valid-empty, invalid-selector, stale, missing-source, and missing-carrier outcomes without fabricated empty populations.

PRE-CREATE DESCRIBE. Add a read-only server-resolved describe operation that works while the derived carrier is absent and returns exact obligation-source, WK/unit, criterion, digest, expected-absence, prospective-carrier, bound, and supported-next-call facts for legitimate create.

MCP FAMILY. Register describe/create/upsert/remove/query through registerControlledContractTools with closed schemas and byte-preserving refusals. Accept no caller repository/source path, digest, generation, count, completeness, currentness, outcome, or provider authority.

AUTHORING SEMANTICS. Create requires server-proven absence and exact described identity; upsert/remove require digest CAS and typed criterion selectors. Missing, stale, duplicate, invalid, oversize, busy, and final-compare failures change no state and preserve distinct codes.
BOUNDS. Preserve the 4,096-row and 1,048,576-byte create bounds and shared bounded gap-first response, content-reference, and digest-bound continuation owners without silent truncation.
ROLE POLICY. Describe/query are visible to orchestrator, reviewer, redteam, operator; create/upsert/remove only to orchestrator/operator; worker receives none.
DISCOVERY PARITY. Registration, schema, descriptor, role policy, discovery, routing, invocation, and completion populations are exact; every advertised next call is callable.
NON-AUTHORITY. Reads are non-authoritative; mutations author only mappings and confer no proof, admission, CCE, dispatch, review, integration, publication, completion, or runtime-proof authority.
REGRESSIONS. Cover describe/create/upsert/remove/query, request self-authentication, currentness/CAS, roles, registration/discovery/routing/callable parity, bounds, and ordinary node:test discovery.
DOCUMENTATION. docs/acceptance-coverage-mcp.md owns the protocol and docs/mcp-integration.md links it without duplicating the catalog.
WK-2415 UNBLOCK. WK-2415 stays blocked until live discovery exposes the family and an orchestrator can use describe plus create/upsert for its exact mappings.

DIRECT-TO-MAIN. Operator-authorized direct-to-main delivery receives one findings-only review of the exact landed commit/range, one disposition, recorded validation/survivors, no terminal-review unit, and no forge handoff.
